faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at Kannur University?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at Kannur University is 25th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc. degree in Physics or an equivalent qualification with at least 60% marks or an equivalent CGPA/grade to be eligible for the Junior Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow post is 28 years. Age relaxation details, if any, will be provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Research Fellow position ranges from Rs. 37,000 to Rs. 42,000 per month, with specific amounts and HRA applicable based on NET/GATE qualification and the year of tenure.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Junior Research Fellow vacancy at Kannur University?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email. Prepare your application with all necessary documents and send it to the official email address provided in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive, as per the available information.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an initial screening based on your eligibility and research experience, followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I attach with my application?
faq.answer: You should attach self-attested copies of all required documents, including educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is recommended to download and read it thoroughly.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow position at Kannur University is a contractual role. This means the appointment is for a fixed period as specified in the contract.
